Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
GEN...@leeds.ac.uk (B.D. Redmond) writes:
>>I have a question about that last bit. Can a vampire,
>using fortitude (or
>>Sideslip), prevent damage to a retainer? Can a retainer
>use a flak jacket?
>>

>The only possible explaination that I can think of is
>that a ghoul retainer might beable to be given a flak
>Jacket (You can give them anything else).

Ghoul Retainers cannot be given anything, just like any
other retainer. Their special ability allows them to
"use" a weapon that their employer isn't using, but
the employer is still the bearer of that weapon, not
the Ghoul Retainer (important in the case of a Zip
Gun or a Bomb). They certainly cannot extend their special
ability to "using" a flack Jacket, since the special
ability only refers to weapons, not generic equipment.

They also could not maneuver with a gun that they were
planning on using later in the round.
